independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the track thickness, the thumb inset, thickness, minimum length and radii, and the corner.
Measurement, Base UI's data-* and CSS variables, thumb drag and track press, shared by both renderers.

intent: Scroll a bounded region with scrollbars that match the theme
Show where more content is (overflow edges)

properties.description: Distance in px from an edge before its data-overflow-*-start / -end applies (Base UI overflowEdgeThreshold; React also takes one per edge).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

content.children: Any content (the preset wraps it in the viewport and content parts), or the parts written out: [data-part=viewport] (› [data-part=content]), [data-part=scrollbar] (data-orientation, keep-mounted) › [data-part=thumb], [data-part=corner].

constraints: Size it: a height or max-height on the host bounds the viewport (the host is a flex column); without one it grows with its content and never scrolls vertically.

Scrolling stays native (wheel, touch, keys in the focused viewport, find-in-page); the viewport's own scrollbars are hidden and the kit's overlay its inline end and block end, so pad the content's end when its text must not sit under a bar.
The scrollbars are pointer affordances (aria-hidden): a thumb drags 1:1 along its track, a press on the track centers the thumb under the pointer. The viewport is focusable while it overflows.

Continuous values reach CSS as custom properties set by script: Base UI's --scroll-area-corner-width / -height (root), --scroll-area-overflow-{x,y}-{start,end} (viewport), --scroll-area-thumb-width / -height (scrollbar) and ours, --scroll-area-thumb-offset.

Composition: React ScrollArea.Root, Viewport, Content, Scrollbar (orientation, keepMounted), Thumb, Corner; the preset ScrollArea wraps its children; every part takes render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string).

avoidWhen.when: A row of slides or cards to page through.
avoidWhen.reason: A swiper snaps to items and has paddles and dots.
The page scrolls with the browser's own scrollbar; a scroll area is for a bounded region inside it.

nodes.summary: The viewport (Base UI ScrollArea.Viewport): scrolls natively, its own scrollbars hidden; role=presentation, tabindex 0 while it overflows; the overflow data-* and --scroll-area-overflow-* variables.
The content (Base UI ScrollArea.Content): the preset's children; min-width fit-content, so wide content overflows horizontally; the overflow data-*.

A scrollbar (Base UI ScrollArea.Scrollbar): a 2u track at the inline end (data-orientation=vertical) or block end (horizontal), 0.5u padding around the thumb; hidden while its axis has no overflow (unless keep-mounted); fades in on data-hovering, data-scrolling or keyboard focus inside; --scroll-area-thumb-width / -height, --scroll-area-thumb-offset.
The thumb (Base UI ScrollArea.Thumb): u thick, at least 4u long, a pill in fg.subtle (fg.muted while scrolling or hovered); drags with pointer capture; data-orientation, data-scrolling.
The corner (Base UI ScrollArea.Corner): the 2u square where both scrollbars meet; hidden unless both axes overflow.
